rule: reject if the feed lacks a usable pit_effective_date / revision_timestamp for a zero-look-ahead as-of join
reject if universe coverage < ~90% of the 545-name panel or median per-name history < 24 months
reject if the sector-neutral revision-momentum factor has no positive 63d IC with |t| that clears the same bar the quality legs did
reject if composite_sn + w*revision does not beat composite_sn net-25bps under the 11-C strict relative test
reject if the edge is turnover cost-killed at 25/50 bps
reject if walk-forward pooled OOS IC is not positive with frac-windows-positive >= baseline
reject unless the net-25bps improvement over baseline survives in BOTH pre-2020 and post-2020 (the 10-N/10-O/11-C subperiod guard)
reject post-hoc winners: no single-quarter / single-sector driver; both cohorts positive; concentration not worse than baseline
